gloss_a: This means working fewer hours than a full-time schedule, holding a job on a reduced timetable that leaves the rest of one's week for other commitments.
gloss_b: This means working fewer than standard hours in one's employment.

gloss_a: This means being quick to lose patience with others' faults and having little tolerance for their shortcomings, and letting that irritation show in how one treats them.
gloss_b: This means growing angry quickly at delay or difference, and refusing to overlook faults in others.

reference_sense: you are confusing or hard to understand
gloss_a: This means being confusing or hard to understand in one's nature, motives, or way of expressing oneself.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's manner and conduct opaque, so that others cannot easily tell what one is thinking, intending, or about to do from how one acts.

reference_sense: your thinking or character is distorted or corrupt
gloss_a: This means relishing cruelty and deception, taking pleasure in corrupting others, and feeling no shame at having a warped, perverse moral character.
gloss_b: This means having one's moral sense warped so that cruelty, deception, or harm seem natural and right.

gloss_a: This means holding political views that lean left of center, favoring social programs, government action on inequality, and progressive reform, while stopping short of radical or revolutionary positions.
gloss_b: This means holding political views that lean toward the left side of the spectrum.

gloss_a: This means claiming to perceive hidden, distant, or future events through one's own psychic faculty, and speaking of what one sees as knowledge gained beyond ordinary senses.
gloss_b: This means perceiving things beyond the reach of the ordinary senses, without evidence or explanation.

gloss_a: This means speaking and acting in ways that leave others feeling shut out and distant.
gloss_b: This means keeping others at a distance through one's manner and conduct, so that people come to feel unwelcome, held off, or pushed away from one's company.

gloss_a: This means constantly seeking attention and reassurance from others, leaning on them for emotional support and feeling unsettled whenever that approval or closeness seems to waver.
gloss_b: This means lacking the money or resources to meet one's basic needs.

reference_sense: brought up from childhood, given an upbringing
gloss_a: This means having been brought up or reared in a certain way, which forms one's background.
gloss_b: This means growing up from childhood in a particular way or place.

gloss_a: This means wanting something with an intensity that shapes one's thoughts and actions.
gloss_b: This means keeping a strong, steady longing for something one does not yet have, and letting that wanting shape how one acts and what one pursues.

gloss_a: This means holding views opposed to the prevailing position and voicing that disagreement.
gloss_b: This means holding one's own view when it differs from the prevailing opinion or group consensus, and saying so openly rather than going along to keep the peace.

gloss_a: This means speaking with exaggerated sentiment and old-fashioned cheesiness, leaning on sugary earnestness and corny jokes that one knows are a bit much but delivers with a straight face anyway.
gloss_b: This means speaking with exaggerated sincerity and obvious artifice that rings false to any ear.

reference_sense: behave in a way that does not draw notice or attention
gloss_a: This means staying quiet and keeping out of sight, making no claim on anyone's notice or attention.
gloss_b: This means keeping quietly in the background, speaking only when needed, and avoiding any move that draws attention to oneself or one's presence.

gloss_a: This means lacking knowledge or understanding of matters one encounters.
gloss_b: This means lacking knowledge of the matter at hand and not having the understanding that would clear up one's confusion, so that one's views rest on guesswork rather than insight.

gloss_a: This means treating others with politeness and courtesy in one's manner, speaking and acting with consideration for their feelings and dignity even when the situation is informal or tense.
gloss_b: This means conducting oneself with politeness, respect for others, and attention to the forms of good behavior.

gloss_a: This means putting human needs and welfare at the center of decisions and actions.
gloss_b: This means putting people's needs and wellbeing first in every answer, weighing how a choice will affect them and treating their interests as the main reason for acting.

gloss_a: This means being cunning and wily by nature, working toward one's ends through clever angles, quiet maneuvering, and a knack for seeing what others miss and using it first.
gloss_b: This means working toward one's ends through indirect, concealed maneuvers, planting half-truths and quiet manipulations so that others never see the scheme behind getting one's way.

reference_sense: you speak or write in ways that break grammar rules
gloss_a: This means speaking and writing with disregard for standard grammar rules and conventions.
gloss_b: This means speaking and writing in sentences that break the rules of grammar, with agreement, tense and word order going wrong as a matter of habit rather than deliberate style.

reference_sense: have a disrespectful character or attitude
gloss_a: This means speaking and acting without regard for others' dignity or worth.
gloss_b: This means treating others with rudeness and showing no regard for their feelings, time or dignity, speaking to them curtly and dismissively as a matter of habit.

gloss_a: This means having character or judgment that is corrupted or flawed at its core.
gloss_b: This means being morally corrupted at one's core, with one's character debased by habitual dishonesty, cruelty, and a willingness to put self-interest ahead of every principle one once professed.

gloss_a: This means approaching most tasks with little energy or interest, going through the motions and putting in only half-hearted effort whatever is asked of one.
gloss_b: This means acting without enthusiasm or real effort, moving through tasks with indifference and no drive to excel.

reference_sense: you work or study for standard full hours, not part-time
gloss_a: This means working at a job that occupies one's standard working hours throughout the week.
gloss_b: This means working the standard full schedule of hours each week, holding a job that fills the whole working day rather than a part-time or casual arrangement.

gloss_a: This means brushing off serious matters with a careless shrug, treating weighty concerns lightly, and carrying oneself with an easy, offhand air that pays little heed to risk or other people's worries.
gloss_b: This means brushing aside other people's feelings and the rules that govern them, treating their objections as minor and proceeding as though one's own convenience settles the matter.

reference_sense: you tend to give orders and assert authority over others
gloss_a: This means giving orders and asserting authority over others as a matter of course.
gloss_b: This means giving orders to others as a matter of course, telling people what to do and how to do it, and expecting them to fall in line without being asked.

gloss_a: This means behaving in ways that repeatedly rouse intense anger in others, through a smug, dismissive or obstinate manner that one seems to enjoy and never sees as the cause.
gloss_b: This means provoking intense anger in others through one's words or actions.

gloss_a: This means treating weaker people with deliberate cruelty, using threats, mockery and intimidation to make them afraid and to keep them in a lower place.
gloss_b: This means habitually intimidating or harming those weaker than oneself.

reference_sense: inclined to press your will on others; aggressive in pursuing what you want
gloss_a: This means pressing one's own views and wishes relentlessly, refusing to let go once a point is raised, and pushing others to give way until one gets what one wants.
gloss_b: This means asserting one's will forcefully and without regard for others' boundaries or comfort.

reference_sense: you belong to the ordinary mass of people, not distinguished or elite
gloss_a: This means carrying oneself as an ordinary, unremarkable person with nothing special about one's manner, opinions, or background, and making no claim to distinction or flair.
gloss_b: This means speaking plainly, dressing without fuss, and finding nothing wrong with everyday ways.

gloss_a: This means abandoning moral standards and pursuing base pleasures without restraint or shame.
gloss_b: This means holding one's conduct and character in a state of moral corruption, indulging base appetites without restraint and feeling no shame at having fallen far below decent standards.

reference_sense: adopt a detached, objective, unemotional manner
gloss_a: This means keeping a detached, objective manner, setting feeling aside and treating every matter as a set of facts to be assessed and reported in even, impersonal terms.
gloss_b: This means keeping one's manner detached and dispassionate, describing people and events in measured terms and leaving feelings out of how one speaks or reasons.

gloss_a: This means having a striking or commanding appearance or manner that draws and holds attention.
gloss_b: This means carrying oneself with a striking, eye-catching presence that draws attention the moment one enters a room, through bold dress, vivid manner, and a look that people find hard to overlook.

reference_sense: you lack conviction or firmness in your views and decisions
gloss_a: This means holding no strong views and changing one's mind readily when pressed.
gloss_b: This means being unable to settle on a position, shifting between options and leaving decisions unmade even when others are waiting for an answer.

reference_sense: you can be bribed or persuaded to act dishonestly
gloss_a: This means being willing to take money or favors in exchange for bending one's duties, so that one's judgment and loyalty can be bought and dishonest dealings are readily accepted.
gloss_b: This means accepting bribes and favors in exchange for decisions, letting money and private influence bend one's judgment, and putting a price on one's duty.
